template.title: The Little Bell‑Bird and the Kind Visitor
template.summary: A child helps a tiny, singing bird and shares a snack, learning a gentle lesson about kindness.

sentences.text_with_blanks: [[slot_child]] loved to play with [[slot_toy]] in the park.
One sunny day, they saw a tiny [[slot_color]] bird perched on a high branch.
The bird sang a song that sounded like a little bell.
[[slot_child]] wondered if the bird could get down.
They tried to shout, but the bird stayed put.
[[slot_child]] almost walked away, thinking the bird would be fine.
Then they remembered the kind rule they learned at school: help a friend.
[[slot_child]] carefully climbed the tree and reached the bird.
The bird hopped onto [[slot_toy]]'s back and flew down.
[[slot_child]] shared a bite of [[slot_snack]] with the bird.
The bird chirped happily and thanked [[slot_child]] with a bright smile.
From then on, the bird visited every [[slot_place]] and sang for [[slot_child]] and [[slot_friend]].
